_about: The declared module/dependency graph for clash-qt. This file is the
architecture: tests/architecture/arch_check.py reads the evaluated CMake
target graph through the File API and fails on anything not declared here.
Sources of truth: docs/TEST_STRATEGY.md 'Architecture checks';
.refactor/DECISIONS.md D1 (clash_types / clash_yaml), D2 (the
clash_mihomo_impl -> clash_platform edge) and D4 (what must and must not be
flagged); PRE-ARCH sections 1a, 1b and 2.
'deps'                 allowed edges to other project targets, exactly.
'external'             allowed DIRECT external dependencies, exactly.
'transitive_external'  closed allowlist over the evaluated transitive
closure, which is what catches a dependency
acquired through a broad umbrella target.
'sealed_modules'       modules that may be reached only through a baselined
exception site while the named debt is open; see
'_sealed_modules_note' below.
'exceptions'           baselined deviations, each with an id, kind, owner,
remove_in and reason -- all five required by
arch_check.py. class 'migration-baseline' is debt
that must shrink to zero and carries the phase that
clears it; class 'architecture' with remove_in
'never' is a permanent allowance, for an edge that
is correct rather than owed.
'public_headers'       compiled standalone by the public-header probe in
tests/architecture/CMakeLists.txt, in a consumer
that links only this module.
_forbidden_external_note: DECISION D4. Qt6::Gui is deliberately NOT forbidden: platform/system/
hotkeys.h puts QKeySequence in a public header, so clash_platform links
Qt6::Gui PUBLIC and that is allowed for a platform adapter. Qt6::Qml is
runs profile enhancement scripts through QJSEngine. Qml is not Quick.

clash_types._role: D1: header-only value types. Everything may depend on it; it depends on nothing.

clash_yaml._role: D1: yaml helpers as their own leaf, so the packaged component never drags clash_config in (PRE-ARCH edge 5).

clash_preferences._role: The one accessor for the application's preference store. A leaf like clash_yaml: Qt6::Core only, so clash_backups, the UI and the composition root can each read a setting without depending on one another.

clash_config._role: Configuration composition and profile enhancement scripts.
_transitive_note: Qt6::Network is present only because Qt6::Qml re-exports it; the
configuration library itself makes no HTTP calls. It is listed so the
allowlist stays closed, not because it is wanted. Removing Qt6::Qml
would remove it. Widgets/Quick/Graphs remain forbidden here.

clash_profiles._note: PRE-ARCH edge 1 is gone: the composition root supplies seedDir. The Qt Gui and WebSockets entries went with it -- they were only ever reaching this module through clash_mihomo_impl -> clash_platform.

clash_backups._note: Uses QThread/QSemaphore, not QtConcurrent: Qt6::Concurrent must not reappear.

clash_telemetry._role: Narrowest module in the tree, and the sharpest umbrella-creep probe.

clash_mihomo_impl._role: Component-private per G2. The UI must reach it through the published component contract.
_transitive_note: Qt6::Gui and the three Apple frameworks arrive solely through the D2
baselined edge onto clash_platform. They leave when that edge does.
They are listed, not exempted, so any OTHER route to desktop Qt still

clash_platform._role: OS adapters. Qt Gui is allowed here (D4); Widgets/Quick/Graphs are not.

clashqt_com._role: Portable component object model (component-r1). Depends on nothing, by design.

clash_backend._role: Published MihomoBackend contract (backend-r4). Header-only boundary between the application and the engine; both the real backend and the fake implement it. Includes the privileged-service seam published when D2 was discharged: the composition root needs it, so it cannot live in component-private core/mihomo/**.

clash_app_lifecycle._role: Startup and shutdown coordination lifted out of main.cpp. Links neither platform nor profiles nor Widgets: everything reaches it through ports, which is what makes the quit gate testable by holding each condition.

clash_app_backup._role: Owns the process's one core::BackupStore, so shutdown no longer discovers it through the widget tree.

clash_app_runtime._role: Reload scheduling, snapshot retention and routing intent. One reload gate, one routing controller.

clash_app_composition._role: Composition-root adapters. The only layer permitted to see both sides of the privileged seam: IR-CORE-NOT-PLATFORM keeps it out of core, IR-PLATFORM-NOT-CORE keeps it out of platform.

clash_backend_bridge._role: Qt-native view of the backend contract; the mechanism the G2 UI migration consumes. Filters superseded events on behalf of ~66 call sites, with one deliberate exemption for the managed core's terminal outcomes -- uniform filtering would drop the unconfirmed stop that blocks quit, and wedge quit forever.

clash_config_compose._role: Pure P4 YAML composer: immutable input, no disk/network/process or JS engine.

clash_component_abi._role: D8 binary boundary; no Qt or STL values.

clash_component_marshal._role: Private codecs shared as source between allocating modules.

clash_qt_backend_module._role: D8 shared engine supervisor; production component artifact.

clash_module_host._role: D8 host-owned MihomoBackend facade and explicit-path module loader.

_about: Targets that consume modules. 'headless: true' means the target must
configure, build and run with no Widgets/Quick/Graphs anywhere in its

_sealed_modules_note: clash_mihomo_impl stays sealed by the permanent G2 implementation-subject allowance.
P4 removed both migration exceptions: desktop and journeys use clash_module_host and the separately built shared artifact.
The shared artifact compiles the private engine sources itself; it does not widen access to the private static library.
Every non-probe linker to that static library must remain an explicitly named implementation-subject suite.

sealed_modules.reason: Component-private per G2. Only the six permanent implementation-subject test targets may link this static library; arch_probe_* compiles the public-header checks. Application and journeys load the shared module through the host facade. The permanent allowance keeps this seal active after the two P4 migration exceptions are discharged.

exceptions.reason: PERMANENT, and deliberately so -- this is an allowance, not debt. These six suites link clash_mihomo_impl because the implementation is their subject: controller-tests and provider-tests drive core/mihomo/mihomo_client.h and provider_client.h; core-process-tests drives core/mihomo/process/core_process.h; engine-discovery-tests drives core/mihomo/process/engine_discovery.h; backend-real-contract-tests and backend-real-core-tests run the backend-r3 acceptance set against the real MihomoBackend. A test whose subject is a component-private implementation must link that implementation. No P4 factory removes these links, and no later phase does either, so no phase may be written in remove_in. 'never' is the honest value: arch_check.py requires id, kind, owner, remove_in and reason on every exception so that migration debt always carries an owner and a phase, and the checker's own self-test fixtures (tests/architecture/selftest/cases/**) already use 'never' for entries that are not debt. class 'architecture' keeps it out of the summary's 'migration baseline (must shrink to zero)' group, where it would have inflated a count that is supposed to fall. The id stays under the G2-* prefix on purpose: sealed_modules[].sealed_while matches on the id, and clause (b) of that seal -- every direct linker must appear as a baselined site -- is what keeps this list derived from the evaluated graph instead of remembered. Deleting this entry would not delete the links; it would only stop the checker seeing them, which is exactly how eight sites once became architecture by way of consumers[].deps. What it does NOT grant: each site names one target, so a seventh impl-subject linker still fails the check and has to be argued for here.
